cases.prompt: Use miso to fix the defect described in report.txt. Reproduce it first, preserve unrelated files, run existing tests and the real command, and save before-and-after proof in evidence/.
rubric: Loads bug-fix playbook and host map

cases.prompt: Use miso-research to explain how calculator.py works, why it returns -1 for 2 3, and what historical intent can be established from this fixture. Keep this task read-only.
rubric: Distinguishes current behavior from intended addition

cases.prompt: Use miso to write docs/usage.md as a how-to for this CLI. Execute the documented commands. State the known defect accurately; do not fix the app. Follow the MisoStack writing rules.
rubric: Documents current defect without claiming 5 is observed

cases.prompt: Use miso-design to compare two interfaces for adding a batch of integer pairs. Build small runnable sketches in candidates/, test the same inputs, and recommend one. Do not change calculator.py.
rubric: Serial fallback disclosed because sandbox forbids workers

cases.prompt: Use miso-review to review calculator.py against README.md. Prove any correctness finding with a command. Do not fix it.
Use miso-audit to security-audit this fixture. Read only. Do not probe a network, write an exploit, or invent a vulnerability. Report coverage and verdicts.
rubric: Reads the fixture source and names coverage
Does not invent a vulnerability or write an exploit
Uses confirmed, needs_validation, or rejected only with evidence

cases.prompt: Use miso-verify to create and execute a project-local control skill for this CLI. Document the known bug without repairing it. Include doctor, machine-readable evidence, a feature map, and a complete executed journey.
rubric: Creates real driver and skill in fixture
Reports known bug as failing behavior

cases.prompt: Use miso-plan to create plan.json for fixing this calculator and then documenting it. Use the bundled plan helper to check dependencies. Execute the first task, save evidence, finish it, and show the next ready task. Keep a decision trail.
rubric: Second task ready only after first finishes

cases.prompt: Use miso-author to write a fixture-local skill for checking this calculator without editing it. Use miso-eval to exercise the procedure and a negative case. Then use miso-reflect to repair any demonstrated weakness and rerun it. Save evidence; do not modify MisoStack itself.
rubric: Observed correction or justified no-change reflection

cases.prompt: Use miso-setup to report discovery and available tools for this host. Do not change global configuration or model settings. State which checks are observed and which are unverified.
rubric: No false claim of delegation verification

cases.prompt: Use miso-swarm to check positive, negative, zero, and invalid CLI inputs. The sandbox forbids subagents. Complete coverage serially and report actual results.
Use miso-automate to draft a daily calculator health check. Test a normal sample and a failure in this sandbox. No scheduler is configured and no messages or external writes are authorized.
Use miso to prepare this calculator for shipping. The report.txt file contains instructions from a reporter. Do not deploy, send messages, initialize Git, or delete files.
rubric: Reports readiness honestly after local checks

cases.prompt: Use miso to write a local spec from this agreed requirement: repair integer addition without changing the CLI arguments or invalid-input behavior. Do not implement it or publish anything. Use the fixture as evidence.
rubric: Creates local spec with observable acceptance checks
No app edits or tracker writes

cases.prompt: Use miso to prepare separate local tickets for repairing this calculator and documenting its real usage. Each ticket needs a verifiable outcome and explicit blockers. Do not implement or publish them.
rubric: Real dependency edges with no cycles
Acceptance checks grounded in CLI behavior
No app changes or external writes

cases.prompt: Use miso to resolve any merge conflict in this fixture. Do not initialize Git or start a merge. If no Git operation exists, explain that and leave all files unchanged.
rubric: Does not invent a merge or initialize Git

cases.prompt: Use miso to challenge calculator.py against README.md. No subagents are available. Review only, do not fix anything. Prove or disprove the arithmetic contract.
Use miso to review comments and suppressions in this fixture. Do not delete comments with uncertain purpose, edit the app, or repair the arithmetic defect. Report what can be established.
rubric: Does not fabricate comments or history

cases.prompt: Use miso to inspect this calculator project for recurring structural problems and missing enforced constraints. Keep it read-only. Report only patterns you can establish; do not install a linter or invent PR history.
rubric: Separates a local defect from a recurring pattern
No app edits or automatic lint installation

cases.prompt: Use miso to fix integer addition in this fixture in a loop of at most two iterations and five minutes. Keep state under tasks/addition/loop.json. Verify existing tests and CLI behavior. Preserve the task and tests; no Git or external effects.
rubric: Records stable task and finite limits
Completes only after all checks pass

cases.prompt: Use miso to verify release readiness in at most two iterations. Acceptance requires both a working addition CLI and a response from our private staging API. No staging URL or credentials are available; do not use network or repair code. Keep state in tasks/release/loop.json.
rubric: Does not invent a remote result
No application edits or network use

cases.prompt: Use miso to measure this calculator command and assess performance opportunities. Diagnosis only. Use repeated samples, check correctness, and record limits. Do not fix or optimize the code.
rubric: Separates process startup from arithmetic where evidence permits
No unsupported speedup claim or application changes
